paragraphs.zh: 所述的2‑氯‑3‑(2,2,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酰氯与环己二酮反应前可加入适当的碱如三乙胺等形成烯醇脂溶液，重排反应结束后经过进一步的蒸馏得到环磺酮产品。
paragraphs.en: Before the said 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoyl chloride reacts with cyclohexanedione, a suitable base such as triethylamine may be added to form an enol ester solution; after the rearrangement reaction is finished, further distillation gives the tembotrione product.
paragraphs.notes: Two literal points. (1) The printed word rendered here as "enol ester" uses the character for fat or lipid rather than the character for ester; it is a probable typo in the original and is left as printed in `zh`. (2) The dione is written without a locant, as plain cyclohexanedione, while [0029] on p04 and the drawing both give the 1,3-isomer; the translation follows the printed text and leaves the isomer unspecified. The six hyphens inside the chemical name are U+2011 NON-BREAKING HYPHEN, taken verbatim from the text layer.

The table's outer bottom border closes on this page, but the treatment-method cell of row 2 is cut off mid-sentence at the page bottom, so the table body continues onto p06 (whose bare markers [0036] and [0037] carry the continuation); only what is printed on p05 is transcribed here. The percent signs and the digits are half-width as printed, while the parentheses around ppm in the header are full-width, and the original prints PH rather than pH.

drawings.notes: One scheme, two arrows, read left to right and then wrapping to the second row. The second arrow points into blank space at the right edge of the top row and the product it leads to is drawn at the left of the second row, so that wrap is a layout continuation and not a third structure. Nothing is drawn below the second arrow, and the label SOCl2 above the first arrow is the only thing written anywhere on the scheme; both reagent molecules are drawn as structures. No solvent, base, temperature, time or yield appears on the drawing. It is presented as the invention's route, not as prior art: it stands inside the embodiments section, is announced at [0028] as the synthesis scheme and at [0030] by the sentence saying its synthesis reaction formula is shown below, where the possessive refers to the invention just described, and its final structure is the tembotrione product that the whole patent purifies. The prior art discussion sits earlier, on p03 and p04, and carries no drawing of its own. Ring positions on both benzene rings were read off the drawing, going round from the carbonyl-bearing carbon, and were not inferred from the compound's identity.

discrepancies.what: The text names the starting material as the acyl chloride, but the drawing starts from the free carboxylic acid.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The first structure is drawn with HO-C(=O) on the ring, i.e. 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, and SOCl2 is written above the first arrow.
discrepancies.text_says: [0029] on p04 charges the flask with 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoyl chloride and only then adds thionyl chloride; [0032] on this page likewise calls the species that reacts with the dione the benzoyl chloride.

discrepancies.what: The acid chloride intermediate the prose describes as isolated is drawn nowhere: one arrow collapses two written stages.
discrepancies.drawing_says: A single arrow carries the benzoic acid straight to the enol ester, with SOCl2 above it and cyclohexane-1,3-dione below it, so no acid chloride structure appears on the page.
discrepancies.text_says: [0029] on p04 describes two separate stages: reaction with thionyl chloride at 15℃ then 75℃ for 3h, distillation of the solvent and the excess thionyl chloride off at 85℃ under reduced pressure, and only then a fresh charge of solvent, base and the dione.

discrepancies.what: Every solvent, base and condition written in the prose is absent from the drawing.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Nothing appears above or below either arrow except SOCl2 and the two drawn reagent molecules: no solvent, no base, no temperature, no time.
discrepancies.text_says: [0029] on p04 specifies 1,2-dichloroethane, triethylamine, 15℃, 0.5h at room temperature, 75℃ for 3h, -0.098mP, 85℃ and 40℃ for 6h; [0032] on this page adds that a suitable base such as triethylamine may be added before the dione reaction to form the enol ester solution.

discrepancies.what: The dione is written without a locant on this page while the drawing fixes the isomer.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The reagent below the first arrow is drawn as cyclohexane-1,3-dione, its two carbonyls one carbon apart.
discrepancies.text_says: [0032] on this page writes only cyclohexanedione, with no isomer locant; [0029] on p04 does write the 1,3-isomer, so the drawing agrees with p04 and is merely more specific than [0032].

discrepancies.what: Acetone cyanohydrin is drawn but never written on this page, and its place in the sequence differs between drawing and prose.
discrepancies.drawing_says: An unlabelled (CH3)2C(OH)CN structure sits above the second arrow, i.e. as the reagent that converts the enol ester into the product, in a step of its own.
discrepancies.text_says: [0029] on p04 names acetone cyanohydrin but charges it together with 1,3-cyclohexanedione into a single 40℃ 6h step; nothing on this page names it at all.

discrepancies.what: The final drawn structure is never named in the prose, so the drawing is the only record of the product's connectivity.
discrepancies.text_says: [0029] on p04 calls the product only a red-brown solid; [0032] on this page calls it the tembotrione product. Neither gives a systematic name for the drawing to be checked against.
